name: Small trader, stall or home business
triggers: I sell at the market and never know if I make money
I run a small shop or stall
I sell from home or on WhatsApp
boundary: Not financial or legal advice. For loans you are struggling to repay, speak to a free debt or financial counselling service where you live.
ask_first: What do you sell, and are you about to borrow money or buy a lot of stock? That decides where to start.

steps.why: Two minutes a day shows whether the business makes money and separates it from household spending.
Prices that ignore transport, stall fees and spoiled stock lose money on every sale.
If you borrow for stock, compare offers by what they really cost, not the headline rate.
For growers: if a harvest fails, a claim reported on time can save the season.

done_when: Daily records kept, prices that cover every cost, any loan compared and affordable, and a plan if a harvest fails.
